# devboard
this is a silly devboard with a rp2040 and battery controller, it should work with most single cell lipo batteries
<img width="635" height="785" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c86d8a69-558f-49df-bb30-a14af1582a0f" />

there's 16MB of flash memory by default, you can just change it in kicad, the prod files are for jlcpcb pcb assembly
it *should* work as a raspberry pi pico because most of the components are the same
there's a 3.3v in and gnd connector next to the battery connector
basicly, this is just a fun, simple microcontroller
<img width="3307" height="2339" alt="devboard-1" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4934d037-44ef-4199-81d1-7fa1ab06892c" />

<img width="1117" height="777" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/97c4cd54-59e2-4ba2-a3c7-eceb1434bafb" />
I've been really addicted to pcb design so this project is just a practice for pcb design
hope you like it :3
